product_metadata.title: MYSKY HOME Blackout Curtains for Living Room Darkening Thermal Insulated 84 Inch Long Light Blocking Grommet Linen Curtains for Bedroom, Blue Vintage Classical Floral Printing, 1 Panel
features: TEXTURED LINEN: These linen curtains are crafted from upgraded thicken fabric, durable and long lasting. Natural textured linen brings luxurious and graceful to your window and room, make the panels more draped and aesthetic. A best choice to decorate your taste of life.

NATURAL BLACKOUT: Linen curtains are crafted from rich faux linen textured fabric, inner woven construction features natural blackout effect, block out sun light and prevent harmful UV ray, reduce the noise and give your 100% privacy.

MULTIPE FUNCTIONS: The linen curtains help to resist cold drafts in winter and block the cool conditioning air from escaping in summer, save spend on heating and cooling your home. These blocks out curtains also can avoid damage to your furniture and floor due to direct sunlight.

PAIR SOLD: 1 panel in package. Each panel measures: 52"W x 84"L|Set measures: 104"W x 84"L. Each panel has 8 anti rust grommets, inner diameter of grommet is 1.6", fit well with standard or decorative curtain rods.

EASY CARE: These airy and breathable linen printing window drapes are easy for cleaning. Machine washable in cold water, use only non-chlorine bleach when needed, tumble dry low and warm iron as needed
